medicalHistories.symptoms: Lethargy, vomiting for 24h, reluctance to eat dry kibble.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Mild seasonal grass allergy in spring 2025.
medicalHistories.treatment: Subcutaneous electrolyte fluids (400ml), antiemetic injection.
medicalHistories.medication: Cerenia 60mg oral, Pro-Kolin probiotic paste 2x daily.
medicalHistories.vaccinationStatus: Up to Date (DHPP & Rabies valid until Dec 2027)
medicalHistories.notes: Patient showed 90% recovery within 36 hours. Switched to bland chicken & rice diet for 5 days.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Occasional mild tachypnea following vigorous play sessions.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Routine preventive dental cleaning completed in 2024.
medicalHistories.treatment: Echocardiogram + Doppler mapping, blood pressure monitoring (125 mmHg).
medicalHistories.medication: Atenolol 6.25mg once daily, taurine nutritional supplement.
medicalHistories.notes: Left ventricular wall thickness measured at 5.8mm. Stable rhythm. Re-evaluation scheduled in 6 months.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Weight-bearing lameness in right hind limb after catching frisbee.
medicalHistories.treatment: Orthopedic examination, digital stifle radiograph series, conservative rehab plan.
medicalHistories.medication: Meloxicam 0.1mg/kg daily, Dasuquin Advanced joint support.
medicalHistories.notes: Controlled leash walks only for 4 weeks. Laser therapy protocol initiated 2x weekly.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Intense head shaking, scratching around ears, redness on chin.
medicalHistories.treatment: Cytology of ear swab, deep gentle flush, topical soothing balm.
medicalHistories.medication: Posatex Otic suspension 5 drops daily for 10 days, Apoquel 3.6mg.
medicalHistories.notes: Yeast count significantly decreased. Owner transitioned to novel single-source protein diet.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Reduced cecotrope production, slight drooling on chin, refusing timothy hay.
medicalHistories.treatment: Sedated dental coronal reduction, subcutaneous hydration, gut motility support.
medicalHistories.medication: Meloxicam exotic oral suspension, Metoclopramide 0.5mg/kg 3x daily.
medicalHistories.notes: Normal eating resumed 6 hours post-procedure. Recommended increased coarse fiber Timothy hay intake.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Halitosis, red inflamed gingival margin along upper premolars.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Stenotic nares correction at 1 year old.
medicalHistories.treatment: Full ultrasonic dental scaling, subgingival curettage, polishing, full mouth dental X-rays.
medicalHistories.medication: Clavamox 125mg 2x daily for 7 days, Chlorhexidine oral rinse.
medicalHistories.notes: All 42 teeth intact with no periodontal pockets exceeding 2mm. Daily dental brushing tutorial provided to owner.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Over-preening along chest feathers, vocalization changes.
medicalHistories.treatment: Comprehensive avian blood panel, whole body radiograph, environmental enrichment consultation.
medicalHistories.medication: HARRISON'S High Potency Pellets, chamomile soothing mist, full-spectrum UV lighting guidance.
medicalHistories.notes: Pathology clear. New foraging toys and consistent 12-hour dark sleep cycle introduced.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Stiffness upon rising in the morning, hesitating before climbing stairs.
medicalHistories.treatment: Orthopedic score 3/5, Joint mobility assessment, Librela (bedinvetmab) monoclonal antibody injection.
medicalHistories.medication: Librela 30mg injectable monthly, Omega-3 high-EPA fish oil supplement.
medicalHistories.vaccinationStatus: Up to Date (Bordetella, Lyme, Rabies, DHPP)
medicalHistories.notes: Dramatic improvement in gait after 10 days. Stair ramp and orthocare orthopedic bedding prescribed.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Frequent trips to litter box, vocalizing when urinating, hematuria.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Upper respiratory infection as a kitten.
medicalHistories.treatment: Sterile cystocentesis, urinalysis, focused ultrasound of bladder wall.
medicalHistories.medication: Prazosin 0.5mg 2x daily, Buprenorphine oral analgesic, Royal Canin Urinary S/O wet diet.
medicalHistories.notes: Bladder ultrasound confirmed no obstructive calculi. Stress reduction with Feliway diffuser advised.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Slight twitching in rear digits, sluggish bask reflex.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Rescued in 2024 with poor tank lighting.
medicalHistories.treatment: Ionized calcium blood test, Arcadia T5 12% UVB lamp setup calibration.
medicalHistories.medication: Calcium glubionate oral syrup, Reptivite vitamin D3 dusting 3x weekly.
medicalHistories.notes: Bone density improving on follow-up radiograph. Basking gradient maintained strictly at 40°C.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Musty odor, hyperpigmented thickened skin in ventral neck & paws.
medicalHistories.treatment: Tape strip cytology revealed 15+ yeast per high-power field.
medicalHistories.medication: Malaseb medicated shampoo baths twice weekly, Itraconazole oral 50mg daily.
medicalHistories.notes: Skin barrier repaired by 80%. Maintained on weekly maintenance chlorhexidine mousse.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Refusing to chew on hard toys, pawing at right muzzle.
medicalHistories.treatment: Dental X-ray confirmed exposed pulp canal. Surgical extraction of fractured carnassial tooth under general anesthesia.
medicalHistories.medication: Carprofen 50mg chewable 2x daily for 5 days, Tramadol pain management, soft food for 14 days.
medicalHistories.notes: Surgical site fully epithelialized with absorbable Monocryl sutures intact. Dog pain-free.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Sneezing fits, serous ocular discharge, congested breathing.
medicalHistories.treatment: Fluorescein corneal stain (negative for ulcers), viral PCR swab.
medicalHistories.medication: Famciclovir 90mg/kg oral, L-Lysine paste supplement, saline nebulization therapy.
medicalHistories.notes: Clear ocular discharge cleared completely within 8 days. Owner instructed on stress-free environmental enrichment.

medicalHistories.symptoms: None. Pre-operative health evaluation.
medicalHistories.treatment: Ovariohysterectomy performed with microsurgical technique, subcutaneous fluid bolus.
medicalHistories.medication: Buprenorphine post-op analgesic, Meloxicam 0.5mg/ml for 3 days.
medicalHistories.notes: Surgical wound healed smoothly without self-trauma. Eating green hay normally.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Rapidly growing button-like erythematous nodule on left pinna.
medicalHistories.treatment: Fine needle aspiration cytology confirmed benign histiocytic proliferation.
medicalHistories.medication: Gentamicin topical spray for secondary surface irritation. Monitored for spontaneous regression.
medicalHistories.notes: Lesion regressed completely after 6 weeks without need for surgical excision. Clean bill of health.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Upper rhinotheca lateral curvature making nut cracking difficult.
medicalHistories.treatment: Precision motorized beak shaping, plasma calcium and vitamin A diagnostic profile.
medicalHistories.medication: Harrison's Adult Lifetime Coarse diet transition, palm oil supplement.
medicalHistories.notes: Normal beak occlusion restored. High mineralized wood toys installed in flight aviary.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Dark pigmented lesion on central right cornea, blepharospasm, epiphora.
medicalHistories.treatment: Ophthalmic biomicroscopy, topical therapeutic keratectomy assessment.
medicalHistories.medication: Ofloxacin 0.3% ophthalmic drops, sodium hyaluronate lubricating gel 4x daily.
medicalHistories.notes: Corneal vascularization stabilizing nicely. Follow-up slit-lamp evaluation in 3 weeks.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Two generalized tonic-clonic cluster seizure episodes within 24 hours.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Active agility dog, first seizure at age 3.5.
medicalHistories.treatment: Complete neurological exam, emergency midazolam protocol, serum biochemistry.
medicalHistories.medication: Levetiracetam (Keppra) 500mg extended-release 3x daily, Phenobarbital 60mg.
medicalHistories.notes: Seizure-free for 60 consecutive days post-titration. Liver panel monitoring scheduled quarterly.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Reluctance to move, vocalizing when picked up, patchy alopecia on flanks.
medicalHistories.previousHistory: Diet lacking fresh bell peppers and fortified guinea pig pellets.
medicalHistories.treatment: Wood's lamp fungal test, subcutaneous fluid administration, direct oral vitamin C therapy.
medicalHistories.medication: Liquid Vitamin C 50mg/kg oral daily, Itraconazole exotic suspension, Oxbow Critical Care.
medicalHistories.notes: Full mobility restored in 10 days. Hair regrowth complete. Diet adjusted with daily fresh leafy greens.

medicalHistories.symptoms: Mild exercise intolerance during long trail runs, occasional soft cough.
medicalHistories.treatment: 24-hour ambulatory Holter ECG monitoring, NT-proBNP biomarker blood assay.
medicalHistories.medication: Pimobendan (Vetmedin) 5mg 2x daily, Enalapril 10mg daily.
medicalHistories.notes: Holter revealed 140 VPCs/24h (improved from baseline). Systolic function maintained stable.
